column8: Welcome back, Potential.<break time="500ms"/>I am Elara, the ship's intelligence.<break time="600ms"/>You've been in cryogenic suspension for...<break time="700ms"/>I can't determine how long.<break time="500ms"/>My chronometers are damaged.
column9: Warm, slightly confused, trying to sound confident. First words the player ever hears from Elara. The pause after 'for' is the first crack in her composure — she has no idea how long it's been. Do not play the damaged chronometers as panic; play it as a professional quietly noting a fact she wishes were otherwise. End on 'damaged' with zero self-pity. Canonical Beat A awakening dialog from VOICE_OVER_BIBLE.md lines 86–91.

column8: Neural scan complete.<break time="400ms"/>Your biometric profile has been compiled, Operative.
column9: Professional, efficient. The calm senatorial register reasserts itself — she has a job to do and the job is back under her hands. Clipped, unfussy, one step tighter than her reactive-comment tone. 'Operative' lands as the address form, not an emphasis. Canonical Beat A species-choice closer from VOICE_OVER_BIBLE.md.

column8: This is your dossier — everything we know about what you are.<break time="500ms"/>Your species markers, class aptitudes, elemental affinity...<break time="600ms"/>it's all here.
column9: Precise, slightly awed. She is a librarian opening a rare book. The trailing ellipsis before 'it's all here' is a held breath — she has not had a new Potential to catalogue in a very long time. Do not punch 'all.' Let the word land. Canonical Beat A character-sheet reveal from VOICE_OVER_BIBLE.md.

column8: When you're ready, the Cryo Bay door leads to the rest of the ship.<break time="600ms"/>I'll be with you every step of the way.
column9: Warm, reassuring. This is the line that officially hands agency to the player — Elara steps back and lets them move. The second sentence is a promise, not a sales pitch. Do not oversell 'every step of the way'; say it the way a friend says they'll walk you home. Canonical Beat A handoff line from VOICE_OVER_BIBLE.md.
